name: app-shell
title: App shell
description: Header frame (navigation toggle, breadcrumb, actions), a sidebar, the page and an aside, one gutter apart; the sidebar is a full-height column that can collapse to a rail; below a width of its own the sidebar and aside become sheets.

:is(.kl-shell-nav, .kl-shell-sheet) > .k.background:
linear-gradient(to right, transparent calc(44px - var(--kl-k1)), var(--kl-seam) 0 44px, transparent 0)
      no-repeat

linear-gradient(to left, transparent calc(44px - var(--kl-k1)), var(--kl-seam) 0 44px, transparent 0)
      no-repeat

.kl-shell[data-kl-sticky-head] > .kl-she.box-shadow:
0 calc(-1 * var(--kl-shell-top)) 0 var(--kl-shell-bg, var(--kl-paper)),
      0 var(--kl-gutter) 0 var(--kl-shell-bg, var(--kl-paper))
